g.text: The real profiler: the click came first.
Chrome DevTools → Performance · recorded trace, regular module · times since navigation
The profiler sees the same order as our markers: click first, app code ~2.3 s later.
A green INP measures how fast the browser handled the event — not whether the sort happened.
